sloka: कुतूहलितया ब्रह्मन्पृच्छामि त्वां महायशः ।आश्चर्याणां बहूनां हि निधिः परमको भवान् ।। ७.७६.५० ॥
transliteration: kutūhalitayā brahmanpṛcchāmi tvāṁ mahāyaśaḥ ।āścaryāṇāṁ bahūnāṁ hi nidhiḥ paramako bhavān ।। 7.76.50 ॥

translations.english: O greatly renowned Brahmana, I ask you out of curiosity, for you are indeed a supreme treasure of many wonders.
